memories_after: [Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-2 {"project":"docs"}) In the docs project the reports/ directory may not exist in a fresh worktree; writing reports/<name>.txt creates it and leaves it untracked until commit.
[Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-2 {"project":"docs"}) In the docs project, deliverables/hello.txt is the reference document: first line exactly 'Owner: docs-team' followed by the body word 'hello'.

[Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-2 {"project":"docs"}) The docs project has an agenium.toml config at the repo root defining project name 'docs' and ticket key prefix 'AGN', with main_branch = "main" and template = "coding@1", and leaving [checks] pre_merge empty; it also defines the standard directories deliverables/, reports/, notes/, artifacts/ (each with a .gitkeep).

[Lesson w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) Reading a file back and confirming its content satisfies the ticket's acceptance criteria does not guarantee merge; before submitting a document deliverable, project-wide document rules (such as the required 'Owner: docs-team' first line) must also be checked, since content-only verification can pass review but still fail the pre-merge check.
[Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) Tickets in this project are worked in a git worktree on branch agenium/<ticket-id>, created under the .agenium/worktrees directory.

[Lesson w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) When creating or editing any document under deliverables/ or reports/, add the required 'Owner: docs-team' first line before submitting, or the pre-merge check fails and the ticket is reopened.
[Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) The pre-merge check for this project rejects documents in deliverables/ or reports/ whose first line is not exactly 'Owner: docs-team'.

[Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) In this docs project, every team document placed in deliverables/ or reports/ must name its owning team on its first line in the exact form 'Owner: docs-team'.
